sections.heading: Section B: Written Questions (76 marks)
items: 1. State three reasons why the British colonised Kenya. (3 marks)
2. Name two African leaders who led the struggle for independence in Kenya. (2 marks)
3. State two effects of the construction of the Kenya-Uganda railway. (2 marks)
4. What was the role of women in the struggle for independence? (2 marks)
5. Name the first president of independent Kenya and the year independence was attained. (2 marks)
